original_request: create a promotion for inactive customers that churned in the last 1year

timing.frequency_cap: 1 send per customer per channel per 7 days

assumptions: Mapped 'inactive customers that churned in the last 1 year' to the At-Risk customer_segment with last_order_date between 2025-05-28 (12 months ago) and 2025-11-28 (6 months ago).
No channel was named in the request, so the brief targets all available channels; the compliance step will filter each customer to the channels they've opted into.
No send date was specified, so defaulted to the start of next business week (2026-06-01), 09:00-20:00 local time.
Restricted to account_status = active — read 'inactive' in the request as a behavioral descriptor (haven't bought), not the CRM's inactive/suspended flags.
Default frequency_cap: 1 send per customer per channel per 7 days; additionally suppress anyone contacted in the last 7 days.
open_questions: The audience filter uses both a 'last_order_after' and 'last_order_before' bound. The current audience-finder schema only reads 'last_order_before'; the lower bound may not be applied unless that skill is updated.
Confirm the start-of-next-week send date (2026-06-01) works — happy to shift to a specific date if there's a campaign calendar.
Confirm DPO sign-off is in place for EU→US data transfer to Klaviyo, Braze, Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads for NL audiences.
human_summary: Win-back promotion for customers in the Netherlands whose last order was between 6 and 12 months ago. Sends Monday 2026-06-01 across all channels; each customer reached only on the channels they've agreed to. Unsubscribed, erasure-requested, withdrawn-consent, inactive and suspended accounts are excluded. Three items to confirm: the lower-bound audience filter is honored downstream, the send date, and the EU→US data-transfer sign-off.
